I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it's from:** Tobias wrote in #central-random yesterday at 9:27 that West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he flagged it to support on #8841.
- **One guess to check:** Tobias called it his "dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two because a 2 Jan handoff note says Pree's dealer account, Marrow Fieldworks, changed hands on 5 Jan. That note doesn't say who took it over, so it's worth confirming with Tobias.
- **Easy to mix up:** I warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an old Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

I only used what Pree can see herself: her team channels and the public files. I didn't look up the ticket's current status.
